senses.gloss:
वै €1 P. (वायति)
—1 To dry, be dried.
—2 To be languid or weary, be exhausted.

वै ind. A particle of affirmation or certainty (indeed, truly,
 forsooth), but it is generally used as an expletive; आपो वै नरसूनवः
 Ms. 1. 10, 2. 231, 9. 49, 11. 78 &c. It is also said to be a vocative
 particle, and sometimes shows entreaty or persuasion (अनुनय).
